articles.title_en: Wind Turbines and Property Values: A Meta-Regression Analysis
articles.title_cn: 风力涡轮机与房产价值：一项元回归分析
articles.abstract_en: A key concern for property owners about the set up of proximate wind turbines is the potential devaluation of their property. However, there is no consensus in the empirical hedonic literature estimating this price-distance relationship. It remains unclear if the proximity to wind turbines reduces, increases, or has no significant effect on property values. This article addresses this ambiguity, combining 720 estimates from 25 hedonic pricing studies in a first comprehensive meta-analysis on this topic. Using Bayesian model averaging techniques and novel publication bias correction methods, I calculate an average of the reported estimates that is free from misspecification and publication bias. In economic terms, I find an average reduction in property values of $$-0.68\%$$ for properties 1.89 miles away, which turns to zero beyond 2.8 miles. Next to publication selection, the studies’ ability to control for confounding factors such as pre-existing price differentials and spatial effects explains the variance in reported effect sizes.
articles.abstract_cn: 房产所有者对附近风力涡轮机设置的一个主要担忧是其房产可能贬值。然而，在实证特征价格文献中，关于这一价格-距离关系并未达成共识。目前尚不清楚靠近风力涡轮机是否会降低、提高或对房产价值无显著影响。本文通过结合720项估计和25项特征价格研究，针对这一主题进行了首次全面的元分析，以解决这一模糊性。利用贝叶斯模型平均技术和新颖的发表偏倚校正方法，我计算了报告估计的平均值，该平均值不受设定错误和发表偏倚的影响。从经济角度看，我发现对于距离风力涡轮机-0.68英里处的房产，其价值平均下降1.89，而超过2.8英里后，这一影响变为零。除了发表选择外，研究控制混淆因素（如先前存在的价格差异和空间效应）的能力也解释了报告效应大小中的方差。

articles.title_en: Protecting Life and Lung: Protected Areas Affect Fine Particulate Matter and Respiratory Hospitalizations in the Brazilian Amazon Biome
articles.title_cn: 保护生命与肺：保护区影响巴西亚马逊生物群落中的细颗粒物和呼吸系统住院
articles.abstract_en: There is growing recognition of the connection between ecosystem conservation and human health. For example, protection of tropical forests can affect the spread of infectious diseases, water quality, and dietary diversity, while forest loss can have important consequences for respiratory health due to the use of fire for converting land to alternative uses in many countries. Studies demonstrating links between ecosystems and health often conclude with recommendations to expand policies that protect natural ecosystems. However, there is little empirical evidence on the extent to which conservation policies actually deliver health benefits when they are implemented in real contexts. We estimate the effects of protected areas (PAs), the dominant type of conservation policy, on hospitalizations for respiratory illness in the Brazilian Amazon biome. We find that doubling upwind PAs reduces PM2.5 by 10% and respiratory hospitalizations by 7% in the months of most active biomass burning. Brazil has an extensive network of PAs, but investments in management and enforcement have declined in recent years. Forest fires have increased dramatically over the same period. We estimate that the value of the health benefits exceed current average expenditures on PA management for the 1/3 of PAs with the largest local populations, although not for PAs in more remote locations. Our findings highlight how quantifying the contributions to the wellbeing of local populations can support conservation objectives, even if global environmental benefits are not a high priority for decision makers.
articles.abstract_cn: 人们越来越认识到生态系统保护与人类健康之间的联系。例如，热带森林的保护可以影响传染病的传播、水质和饮食多样性，而森林丧失可能对呼吸系统健康产生重要影响，因为在许多国家，火灾被用于将土地转换为其他用途。证明生态系统与健康之间联系的研究通常以扩大保护自然生态系统政策的建议作为结论。然而，关于保护政策在实际情境中实施时究竟能在多大程度上带来健康益处的经验证据很少。我们估算了保护区（PAs）——占主导地位的保护政策类型——对巴西亚马逊生物群落中呼吸系统疾病住院的影响。我们发现，在生物质燃烧最活跃的月份，上风向保护区面积翻倍会使PM2.5减少10%，呼吸系统住院减少7%。巴西拥有广泛的保护区网络，但近年来管理和执法方面的投资有所下降。同期森林火灾急剧增加。我们估计，对于当地人口最多的1/3的保护区，健康益处的价值超过了当前保护区管理的平均支出，尽管对于更偏远地区的保护区并非如此。我们的发现强调了量化对当地居民福祉的贡献如何能够支持保护目标，即使全球环境效益对决策者来说不是高度优先事项。

articles.title_en: Nudging the Food Basket Green: The Effects of Commitment and Badges on the Carbon Footprint of Food Shopping
articles.title_cn: 推动食品篮变绿：承诺与徽章对食品购物碳足迹的影响
articles.abstract_en: We use an incentive-compatible experimental online supermarket to test the role of commitment and badges in reducing the carbon footprint of grocery shopping. In the experiment, some participants had the opportunity to voluntarily commit to a low carbon footprint basket before their online grocery shopping; the commitment was forced upon other participants. We also study the impact of an online badge as a soft reward for the achievement of a low carbon footprint basket. Participants from the general population shopped over two weeks, with the experimental stimuli only in week 2; and received their shopping baskets and any unspent budget. Results indicate that requesting a commitment prior to entering the store leads to a reduction in carbon footprint of 9–12%. When the commitment is voluntary, reductions are driven by consumers who accept the commitment. Commitments also reduced the consumption of fats and, for forced commitments, that of salt by 18%. Badges did not significantly impact consumer behaviour. Commitment mechanisms, either forced or voluntary, appear effective in motivating an environmental goal and search for low-carbon options, particularly in those accepting the commitment.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个激励相容的实验性在线超市来测试承诺和徽章在减少食品杂货购物碳足迹中的作用。在实验中，一些参与者在进行在线食品杂货购物前有机会自愿承诺低碳足迹的购物篮；其他参与者则被强制要求做出承诺。我们还研究了在线徽章作为实现低碳足迹购物篮的软奖励的影响。来自普通人群的参与者进行了为期两周的购物，实验刺激仅在2周出现；他们收到了所购商品篮和任何未花费的预算。结果表明，在进入商店前要求承诺会导致碳足迹减少9-12%。当承诺是自愿的时，减少由接受承诺的消费者驱动。承诺还减少了脂肪的消费，对于强制承诺，盐的消费减少了18%。徽章并未显著影响消费者行为。承诺机制，无论是强制还是自愿，似乎在激励环境目标和寻找低碳选择方面有效，尤其是在那些接受承诺的人中。

articles.title_en: The Recreational Value of the Baltic Sea Coast: A Spatially Explicit Site Choice Model Accounting for Environmental Conditions
articles.title_cn: 波罗的海海岸的休闲价值：考虑环境条件的空间显式选址模型
articles.abstract_en: The coast plays a significant recreational role in the nine countries around the Baltic Sea. More than 70% of the population of these countries visit the coast, representing some 80 million recreational visits annually. Understanding the values associated with coastal recreation, and the potential welfare changes resulting from improvements in the state of environmental and infrastructure conditions of the Baltic Sea coast is important for marine environment management in the region. We estimate a spatially explicit travel cost model for Baltic coast recreation to assess the welfare of accessing individual sites, identify recreational hot spots and simulate the welfare changes resulting from improvements in environmental and infrastructure conditions. The total benefits associated with Baltic Sea coast-based recreation amount to 27.5 billion EUR per year with significant variation across sites. Improving water quality and infrastructure boost the recreational value by nearly 6.2 billion EUR, an increase of about a fifth of the existing recreational benefits.
articles.abstract_cn: 海岸在波罗的海周边九国的休闲活动中扮演着重要角色。这些国家超过70%的人口会到访海岸，每年代表约80万次休闲访问。了解与海岸休闲相关的价值，以及波罗的海海岸环境和基础设施状况改善可能带来的福利变化，对于该地区的海洋环境管理至关重要。我们估计了一个空间显式的旅行成本模型，用于波罗的海海岸休闲，以评估访问各个地点的福利，识别休闲热点，并模拟环境和基础设施改善带来的福利变化。波罗的海海岸休闲的总效益每年达27.5亿欧元，各地之间存在显著差异。改善水质和基础设施使休闲价值增加近6.2亿欧元，约为现有休闲效益的五分之一。

articles.title_en: Voting Sustains Intergenerational Cooperation, Even When the Tipping Point Threshold is Ambiguous
articles.title_cn: 投票维持代际合作，即使临界点阈值模糊
articles.abstract_en: Sustaining future generations requires cooperation today. While individuals’ selfish interests threaten to undermine cooperation, social institutions can foster cooperation in intergenerational situations without ambiguity. However, in numerous settings, from climate change to the biodiversity crisis, there exists considerable ambiguity in the degree of cooperation required. Such ambiguity limits the extent to which people typically cooperate. We present the results of an intergenerational public goods game, which show that a democratic institution can promote cooperation, even in the face of ambiguity. While ambiguity in previous work has proved a challenge to cooperation (although we find sometimes only small and non-significant effects of ambiguity), voting is consistently able to maintain sustainable group-level outcomes in our study. Additional analyses demonstrate that this form of democracy has an effect over and above the impact on beliefs alone and over and above the structural effects of the voting institution. Our results provide evidence that social institutions, such as democracy, can buffer against selfishness and sustain cooperation to provide time-delayed benefits to the future.
articles.abstract_cn: 维持未来世代需要当下的合作。虽然个人的自私利益可能破坏合作，但社会制度可以在没有模糊性的代际情境中促进合作。然而，在从气候变化到生物多样性危机的众多情境中，所需合作程度存在相当大的模糊性。这种模糊性限制了人们通常合作的程度。我们展示了一个代际公共品博弈的结果，表明民主制度即使在面对模糊性时也能促进合作。虽然先前研究中的模糊性已被证明对合作构成挑战（尽管我们发现有时模糊性的影响很小且不显著），但在我们的研究中，投票始终能够维持可持续的群体层面结果。额外分析表明，这种民主形式的影响超出了仅对信念的影响，也超出了投票制度的结构性影响。我们的结果提供了证据，表明诸如民主之类的社会制度可以缓冲自私行为，并维持合作，为未来提供延迟的收益。

articles.title_en: The Climate Actions and Policies Measurement Framework: A Database to Monitor and Assess Countries’ Mitigation Action
articles.title_cn: 气候行动与政策测量框架：监测和评估各国减缓行动的数据库
articles.abstract_en: There are major gaps in the measurement of the adoption and stringency of countries’ climate actions and policies, notably in a manner coherent across countries, time, sectors, and instrument types. The Climate Actions and Policies Measurement Framework (CAPMF) aims to fill this gap. It is the most extensive structured and internationally harmonised climate mitigation policy database available to date. Currently, it comprises 130 policy variables, grouped into 56 policy instruments and other climate actions, covering 50 countries and the EU-27 as a block for the period 1990–2022. Results indicate that countries strengthened their climate action between 1990 and 2022 in terms of policy adoption and policy stringency, although at different paces. Policy adoption, policy stringency and policy mixes changed over time and differ substantially across countries and country groups. Importantly, regression analysis suggests a significant relationship between stronger climate action and greater emission reductions. Mitigation policies helped reduce emissions by about 12% in the last 5 years; most of this effect is attributable to a reduction in the energy intensity of the economy, and only residually to other factors such as a reduction of GHG intensity.
articles.abstract_cn: 在衡量各国气候行动和政策的采纳程度与严格性方面存在重大缺口，尤其是在跨国家、时间、部门和工具类型的一致性方面。气候行动与政策测量框架（CAPMF）旨在填补这一缺口。它是迄今为止最广泛的结构化且国际协调的气候减缓政策数据库。目前，它包含130个政策变量，归类为56个政策工具和其他气候行动，覆盖50个国家和欧盟27作为一个整体，时间跨度为1990-2022。结果表明，在1990至2022期间，各国在政策采纳和政策严格性方面加强了其气候行动，尽管步伐不同。政策采纳、政策严格性和政策组合随时间变化，并在不同国家和国家组之间存在显著差异。重要的是，回归分析表明，更强有力的气候行动与更大的减排量之间存在显著关系。减缓政策在过去12%年中帮助减少了约5的排放；这一效应大部分归因于经济能源强度的降低，而其他因素如温室气体强度的降低仅起残余作用。

articles.title_en: Corporate Social Responsibility, Environmental Emissions and Time-Consistent Taxation
articles.title_cn: 企业社会责任、环境排放与时间一致性税收
articles.abstract_en: We formally model a Cournot duopoly market in which a corporate socially responsible (CSR) firm interacts with a profit-maximizing firm and where the market is regulated with an emission tax. We consider three different kinds of CSR firm behaviors: (i) consumer-friendly; (ii) environmentally-friendly; and (iii) consumer-environmentally friendly. Unlike most theoretical works within this literature, which typically use specific functional forms, we use general structures for the inverse demand function, the cost function, and for emission levels and damage functions. In terms of modeling strategy, we use two game-theoretic approaches: (i) a simultaneous game and (ii) a sequential three-stage ex-post game, in which decisions are time consistent. We found that the optimal emissions taxation rule is modified when considering different CSR motivations. We show that depending upon the CSR motivation and the price elasticity of demand in some cases we can obtain optimal emission tax rates higher, lower, or equal to marginal external emission. Finally, we also found that firms adopting consumer-friendly CSR behavior are more effective in improving the environment compared to environmentally friendly firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们正式构建了一个古诺双寡头市场模型，在该市场中，一家承担企业社会责任（CSR）的企业与一家利润最大化企业互动，并且该市场受到排放税的监管。我们考虑了三种不同类型的企业社会责任行为：（i）消费者友好型；（ii）环境友好型；（iii）消费者与环境双重友好型。与这一文献中通常使用特定函数形式的大多数理论工作不同，我们使用逆需求函数、成本函数、排放水平和损害函数的一般结构。在建模策略方面，我们使用了两种博弈论方法：（i）同时博弈和（ii）序贯三阶段事后博弈，其中决策是时间一致的。我们发现，在考虑不同的企业社会责任动机时，最优排放税规则会被修改。我们表明，根据企业社会责任的动机和需求的价格弹性，在某些情况下，我们可以获得高于、低于或等于边际外部排放的最优排放税率。最后，我们还发现，采用消费者友好型企业社会责任行为的企业在改善环境方面比环境友好型企业更有效。

articles.title_en: Promotion Incentives and Environmental Regulation: Evidence from China’s Environmental One-Vote Veto Evaluation Regime
articles.title_cn: 晋升激励与环境规制：来自中国环保“一票否决”考核制度的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper applies a difference-in-differences approach to examine the effectiveness of China’s One-Vote Veto environmental regulation regime, which links pollution reduction targets with local officials’ promotion. Using a rich set of data for 286 Chinese cities, we show that the new political incentive induced significant tradeoff between economic growth and environmental protection. The regime shifts significantly reduced industrial SO2 emissions; however, the environmental improvement was limited only to the reduction of the targeted pollutants that are linked to performance evaluation. Firm-level evidence shows that emission reduction was mainly achieved by reducing new polluting production activities, increasing pollution abatement capacity and improving abatement performance. It is also found that compliance with emissions reduction targets indeed increases the promotion chances of local officials.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文采用双重差分法考察中国环保“一票否决”考核制度的有效性，该制度将污染减排目标与地方官员晋升挂钩。利用中国286个城市的丰富数据，我们发现新的政治激励导致了经济增长与环境保护之间的显著权衡。该制度显著减少了工业SO2排放；然而，环境改善仅限于与绩效评估挂钩的目标污染物的减少。企业层面的证据表明，减排主要通过减少新的污染生产活动、提高污染治理能力和改善治理绩效来实现。研究还发现，完成减排目标确实增加了地方官员的晋升机会。

articles.title_en: The Impact of Wind Energy on Air Pollution and Emergency Department Visits
articles.title_cn: 风能对空气污染和急诊就诊的影响
articles.abstract_en: Using daily variation in wind power generation in the western portion of Texas, we show that the resulting lower fossil fuel generation in the eastern portion of the state leads to air-quality improvements and, subsequently, to fewer emergency department (ED) visits. Spatially, the impact on pollution is widespread, but wind energy reduces ED admission rates more in zip codes closer to coal plants. Using intra-day wind generation and electricity pricing data, we find that more wind generation coming from hours when congestion on the electricity grid is less leads to higher reductions in emissions from east Texas power plants and PM2.5 concentrations and ED admission rates in east Texas. Comparing wind generation effects across low-demand night hours to higher-demand day hours, more NO $$_\text {X}$$ and SO $$_2$$ is offset by wind from night hours, but the time-dependent effects for PM2.5 concentrations and ED admission rates is much weaker, potentially due to differences in exposure.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用德克萨斯州西部风力发电的日变化，我们表明该州东部化石燃料发电量的减少导致空气质量改善，进而减少了急诊就诊次数。在空间上，污染影响广泛，但风能减少急诊入院率在靠近燃煤电厂的邮政编码区域更为显著。利用日内风力发电和电价数据，我们发现，当电网拥堵较少时，来自这些时段的风力发电量增加，会导致德克萨斯州东部电厂排放、PM2.5浓度和急诊入院率更大幅度下降。比较低需求夜间时段与高需求白天时段的风力发电效应，夜间时段的风力发电抵消了更多的NO $$_\text {X}$$和SO $$_2$$，但PM2.5浓度和急诊入院率的时间依赖性效应要弱得多，这可能是由于暴露差异所致。

articles.title_en: Leaving Home: Cumulative Climate Shocks and Migration in Sub-Saharan Africa
articles.title_cn: 离家：撒哈拉以南非洲的累积气候冲击与迁移
articles.abstract_en: We combine a multi-country household panel dataset with high-resolution gridded precipitation data to investigate how cumulative climatic shocks affects the decision to leave the households in five sub-Saharan African countries. We find that while the effect of recent adverse weather shocks is on average modest, the cumulative effect of a persistent exposure to droughts over several years leads to a significant increase in the probability for a household member to leave the household. We speculate that this pattern can be indicative of increased migratory flows due to increase in the frequency of extremes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将一个多国家庭面板数据集与高分辨率网格化降水数据相结合，研究累积气候冲击如何影响五个撒哈拉以南非洲国家家庭成员离家的决策。我们发现，虽然近期不利天气冲击的影响平均而言较为温和，但多年持续暴露于干旱的累积效应会显著增加家庭成员离家的概率。我们推测，这种模式可能表明，由于极端事件频率的增加，迁移流动有所增加。
